answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 736 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ferrous. The voyage index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the wharf queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A farm of 25 pays that 172 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
